question: we started working with a new organisation

articles.title: Add a company
articles.body:
1. Go to **Companies**.
2. Select **New company**.
3. Enter the **Company name**. All other fields are optional.
4. Optionally add the **Industry**, **Phone**, **Website** and **Address**.
5. Select **Save company**.

To add people to the company, link each contact to it.

answer:
Add the organisation as a company:

1. Go to **Companies**.
2. Select **New company**.
3. Enter the **Company name**. All other fields are optional.
4. Optionally add the **Industry**, **Phone**, **Website** and **Address**.
5. Select **Save company**.

To add people who work there, link each contact to the company.
